model.structure: F03 REVISION 2's joint engine re-implemented parameter-for-parameter: FY26 print A ~ N(35.72,0.58) with C04 rev 2's 50% floor defence; latent reinvestment intensity z tilting the regime log-odds (T1 +0.5, T5 +0.8, T3 -0.2, T4 -0.7); T1 floor = A - clip(1.25+0.4z+U(-0.75,0.75),0.25,3.0) rounded down to 0.5; T2 floor = A - U(0,0.25) rounded down to 0.5. Literal Yes if T5 or floor < round(A,1); material Yes if T5 or floor <= round(A,1) - 0.5.
